payout_quote: This month, TopCashback members can earn a $40 bonus for every friend they refer... When your friend signs up using your link and earns $10 in Cash Back within 180 days, you'll receive a $40 bonus. There's no limit to how many friends you can invite, so the rewards can add up quickly... This special promotion runs during the following dates: September 15, 2026 (12:00 a.m. PT) - September 28, 2026 (11:59 p.m. PT). (Official TopCashback blog, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus credited after the friend's $10 in cash back becomes payable (retailer confirmation can take weeks)
eligibility: TopCashback member; friend must be new, sign up via your link, and earn $10 in cash back within 180 days
steps: Share it with friends who shop online
Friend signs up via your link and earns $10 in cash back within 180 days
You receive $40 per friend - no limit
catches: TIME-SENSITIVE: the $40 rate is a September promo ending September 28, 2026 (5 days from verification) - the standard referral bonus has been $10

Referral bonuses cannot be combined with new member signup bonuses
Cash back only counts after the retailer's return window passes - returned purchases don't count
biggest_catch: The $40 rate EXPIRES September 28, 2026 - after that the bonus drops back toward $10. And your friend's $10 in cash back must be retailer-confirmed, which takes weeks.
